name: captain-archer-imbued-look-six-put-deep-wind-ally-distant-rest-bottom
notes: Captain Archer (disqw3d0o5), imbued with four revealed wind cards: the only wind ally (Baby Green Slime, reserve cost 2) is the 5th of the top six, after a wind SPELL decoy (Fairy Whispers), followed by a Charge the Soul marker as the 7th card. It can only be offered if all six were looked at; it enters distant and the other five go to the bottom in their original order (not the top). Pre-fix only the top card was looked at.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: If Captain Archer is imbued, look at the top six cards of your deck. You may put a wind element ally card with reserve cost 3 or less from among them onto the field distant. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Four defects in the generated enterAbilities["disqw3d0o5:0"] body and its Enter-1 handler. (1) The six-card look was a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever looked at. (2) The rest went back with PutTempZoneOnTopOfDeck() (the TOP of the deck, in reversed order) instead of the bottom. (3) The "may put" follow-up CUSTOM was added without dontSkipOnPass, so declining skipped it and stranded the looked-at card in myTempZone. (4) The reserve-cost check called CardCost(), which does not exist in GrandArchiveSim: a wind ally among the looked-at cards would have been a fatal 'undefined function'. The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so both closures are overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone(), the new PutTempZoneOnBottomOfDeck() (Custom/GameLogic.php), CardCost_reserve() and dontSkipOnPass:1.
